ops.title: _tool_output returns a dict for Bash events, crashing _run_url with TypeError on every gh-run PostToolUse
ops.description:
The ci-triage nudge crashes on every `gh run` PostToolUse whose tool_response is a dict. Still present on current main (a9125c9, the 0.47.10 release commit) — NOT fixed between 0.46.3 and 0.47.10.

## The bug

plugin/capt-hook/hooks/record.py:917

    def _tool_output(evt: BaseHookEvent) -> str:
        return getattr(evt, "tool_response", None) or ""

The `-> str` annotation is a lie. `evt.tool_response` is whatever the hook payload carries, and for a Bash PostToolUse that is a dict (`{'stdout': ..., 'stderr': ...}`). `getattr(...) or ""` only replaces falsy values, so a non-empty dict passes through unchanged.

plugin/capt-hook/hooks/record.py:1003

    def _run_url(evt: BaseHookEvent) -> str | None:
        for text in (evt.cmd.raw, _tool_output(evt), _event_error(evt)):
            if m := RUN_URL_RE.search(text):
                return m.group(0)
        return None

`text` is handed straight to `RUN_URL_RE.search` with no coercion and no type guard, so the dict reaches `re.Pattern.search` and raises.

## Observed traceback

From capt-hookd's log (~/Library/Caches/captain-hook/host-v1/capt-hookd.log) on yasyf's Mac, most recent 2026-07-25 17:30:29, running the 0.46.3 plugin-cache copy under capt-hook 12.20.9:

    File ".../cc-notes/0.46.3/capt-hook/hooks/record.py", line 1088, in nudge_ci_triage_investigation
        url = _run_url(evt)
    File ".../cc-notes/0.46.3/capt-hook/hooks/record.py", line 1005, in _run_url
        if m := RUN_URL_RE.search(text):
           │    │          │      └ {'stdout': 'verify-tag-on-main\tUNKNOWN STEP\t2026-07-25T22:46:22.3452327Z   PLUGIN_MANIFEST: \nverify-tag-on-main\tUNKNOWN S...
    TypeError: expected string or bytes-like object, got 'dict'

The captured `text` value shows the trigger: a `gh run view --log-failed` result, which is exactly the shape `_run_url` exists to scan. The hook fails on its own primary input.

**27 occurrences** in that log, 5 of them within the last hour of observation. Frequency tracks CI-watching activity.

## Current main is affected

Verified against a9125c9 (`chore(release): sync plugin.json to 0.47.10`):

- record.py:917 `_tool_output` — unchanged, still returns tool_response uncoerced.
- record.py:1005 `_run_url` — unchanged, still calls `RUN_URL_RE.search(text)` with no guard.

Nothing between 0.46.3 and 0.47.10 addresses it, so there is no fixing commit to cite. The 0.46.3 plugin-cache copy in the traceback is where it was caught, not the reason it happens.

## Sibling call site with the same defect

plugin/capt-hook/hooks/record.py:925

    def _output_investigation_id(evt: BaseHookEvent) -> str | None:
        text = _tool_output(evt) or _event_error(evt)
        if not text:
            return None
        if m := re.search(r'"id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', text):

Same path: `_tool_output` result goes to `re.search` with only a falsy check, which a non-empty dict passes. Any fix must cover this too, or the crash just moves.

`_event_error` (record.py:921) has the identical `getattr(...) or ""` shape and the same annotation problem, though `error` is likelier to actually be a string.

## Suggested fix

Coerce inside `_tool_output` rather than at each call site — extract the text fields from a dict tool_response (stdout/stderr are what these regexes want) and fall back to `str(...)` for other non-str shapes. Fixing it centrally makes the `-> str` annotation honest and covers `_run_url` and `_output_investigation_id` together. A test with a dict-shaped `tool_response` carrying a run URL in `stdout` would have caught this.

ops.text: _tool_output coerces a non-str tool_response (dict) to a string, or every caller guards before passing it to a regex
A PostToolUse on 'gh run view --log-failed' no longer raises TypeError in the ci-triage nudge path
_output_investigation_id is covered by the same fix, not just _run_url
